scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.build:docker: node scripts/generate-version.js && docker build --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) --build-arg GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) --build-arg GIT_DATE=$(git log -1 --format=%cd --date=short) --build-arg GIT_MESSAGE="$(git log -1 --format=%s)" --build-arg GIT_COUNT=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) -t bdekkernl/atlas:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) -t bdekkernl/atlas:latest -t atlas-atlas:latest .
scripts.push:docker: docker push bdekkernl/atlas:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && docker push bdekkernl/atlas:latest
